message:
Now let me verify the PDF is valid by checking if there's a way to test it locally. Let me check if there's a built poppler binary or if I can build one:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>ls /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/poppler/utils/ 2>/dev/null && echo "===" && find /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul -name "pdftoppm" -o -name "pdfinfo" -o -name "pdftocairo" 2>/dev/null</｜｜DSML｜｜>
